title: Statehood

title: Capital: Santa Fe
d: Santa Fe is the capital of New Mexico.
definition: Santa Fe is the capital of New Mexico.
description: Santa Fe has been the seat of New Mexico government, home to the capitol building, the supreme court, and the legislature. Capitals are often not the biggest city — New Mexico's largest is Albuquerque — chosen instead for geography or politics. Visit the capitol: the building itself tells the state's story in stone.
